skill.summary: Provide tailored safety checklists and guidelines to minimize risks and handle disputes when selling items on online marketplaces.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Online Marketplace Sale Safety Kit.
- Provides red-flag scam checklist, payment boundaries, and safe meetup rules for sellers.
- Includes handover checklist and a dispute record template.
- Designed to help sellers plan safer transactions on online marketplaces.
- Clearly outlines safety boundaries and encourages use of official platform guidance.
